subject: Re: EgoSocial kickoff - social awareness eval for assistant products
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing: Freya 50% (EgoSoD baseline + social thinking graph work), Quentin 40% (eval design, Evalline onboarding), Wanjiru 60% (data engineering).

Tooling plan: the regeneration path is ffmpeg-based frame and audio extraction from the downloaded Ego4D clips, which is straightforward. The bigger problem is coverage - 13,500 pairs is thin for the rarer social configurations (overlapping speakers, >4 participants), and we need controllable training data there. Nothing internal does this, so I'm standing up a synthetic-data generation pipeline from scratch - Wanjiru owns it at 60% through April, building the scenario generator, the audio/visual compositing stage, and the QA sampler. That's the majority of her allocation, but without it the eval has blind spots exactly where assistants fail.

Compute: 32 A100s on titan-a100, best effort, mostly for EgoSoD training runs. No reservations needed.

Deshawn
